answer: Think of Pilot medical certificate with aviation authority attestation as a toll booth: a medical certificate number that checks out in the aviation authority register, so the dawn of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The trellis is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The cipher is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
